representation: CPU float32 reconstruction of frozen checkpoint entity arms, validated against the C demo; not bit-identical native BF16 activations.
split: Entire environment streams, shared across score/depth corpora: train 0–3, validation 4–5, test 6–7.
targets: Reconstruct each policy's own omitted 16-dimensional summaries. Readouts are trained; encoders stay frozen.
limitation: Shared off-policy historical corpus; decoding is not evidence of causal use or guaranteed on-policy generalization.
